task: Implement and run Playwright end-to-end tests for the approved core user journeys. Audit the existing test setup first and do not install dependencies or modify files until the user approves the dry-run plan.
workflow: Inspect repository, existing tests, scripts, API contracts and test data setup.
Report existing E2E tooling and commands.
If Playwright is absent, propose installation and wait for explicit approval.
Create a phase plan with exact files, test data strategy, risks, rollback and verification.
Write independent tests that use accessible roles and labels rather than brittle CSS selectors.
Use isolated test data per test and clean it up safely.
Run headless tests and capture screenshots/traces only on failure.
Fix failures only after identifying root causes and getting approval for file changes.

tenant: Access messaging only after allowed interaction state

negative_cases: Expired session or unauthenticated API response
rules: Test what users see, not implementation details.
Use test fixtures or approved seed data, never real personal information.
Do not invent API contracts or bypass authorization to make tests pass.
Separate backend contract failures from frontend rendering failures.
Run lint, typecheck and build where configured.
Never modify node_modules, .git, dist or build.
Ask before dependency installation, destructive data operations, migrations or production configuration changes.
